source_evidence: State law gives you a set number of days (usually 10 to 30 days) to change your mind about buying an annuity after you receive the annuity contract.
answer: An annuity free look period is a set time after you receive the contract when state law allows you to change your mind about buying it. The period is usually 10 to 30 days, but the length and return process can vary. Check your contract to see how long your free look period lasts and how to return it.
